page.content:
Counter-intelligence officer and crossbow specialist close to Snake Eyes.

How Scarlett connects

  • Faction: G.I. Joe team — Scarlett is the counter-intelligence specialist of the G.I. Joe team.
  • Character: Snake Eyes — Scarlett is Snake Eyes's closest partner on the Joe team.

What is Scarlett?

Scarlett is Shana M. O'Hara, the Joe team's intel and martial-arts specialist whose file card and comic arc tie her to Snake Eyes and to the early command staff beside Duke.

Key threads lead to G.I. Joe team and Snake Eyes.
